# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


# ---
def contact_rows(students: List[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Name, section and email in aligned columns."""
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students to list")
    for pupil in students:
        if not pupil.email:
            raise ProjectError(
                f"no email for {pupil.display_name}"
            )
    ordered = sorted(
        students, key=lambda pupil: pupil.display_name
    )
    name_wide = max(
        len(one.display_name) for one in ordered
    )
    sect_wide = max(len(one.section) for one in ordered)
    return [
        f"{pupil.display_name:<{name_wide}}  "
        f"{pupil.section:<{sect_wide}}  {pupil.email}"
        for pupil in ordered
    ]
after.tests/test_contacts.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows


class ContactRowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows([
            Student("2", "Wu", "Amy", "B1", "amy@x.org"),
            Student("1", "Adams", "Bob", "A10", "bob@x.org")
        ])
        self.assertEqual(rows, [
            "Adams, Bob  A10  bob@x.org",
            "Wu, Amy     B1   amy@x.org"
        ])

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as caught:
            contact_rows([Student("1", "Wu", "Bob", "A")])
        self.assertIn("Wu, Bob", str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
